data.name: Dinu
data.gender_notes: Dinu is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Dinu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Dinah' which means day or light. In Hindu mythology, Dinu is believed to represent the divine force of light and wisdom. It is a name of spiritual significance and is often given to children as a symbol of hope, enlightenment, and knowledge. The name Dinu carries the meaning “Day, Light” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dinu usually hope their child will grow to embody day, light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A beacon of light in the spiritual journey.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dinu total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
